authorityBoundary: creator royalty accounting, statement projection, settlement recovery, audit and selective disclosure

qualification.purpose: reproduce the committed JavaScript dependency graph without lifecycle side effects

prevent legacy payment/status authority and other source-level economic regressions, including checkpoint compiler, signer-custody, signer-trust, trust-anchor, statement-root-trust, audit-capsule and audit-issuer bypass
strictly type-check the accounting authority boundary

run economic conservation, settlement recovery, statement, audit, disclosure, lineage-checkpoint, compiler, signer-capability, trust-rotation, trust-anchor, statement-root-trust, audit-capsule-v2 and audit-issuer-attestation regressions

promotionRule: Every qualification item must succeed after the workflow has checked out and mechanically verified the exact proposed head commit. Missing, queued, skipped, stale, synthetic-merge-only, source-only, or ancestor evidence is not PASS.
forbiddenClaims: A queued or absent workflow is green evidence.
A synthetic pull-request merge ref is exact-head evidence.
A RoyaltyPayment row creates or extinguishes a royalty obligation.
A worker queue is settlement authority.
Submitted, accepted or confirmed rail state is final settlement.
Merkle inclusion proofs are zero-knowledge proofs.
A DDEX or CISAC CRD projection is the internal accounting ledger.
A serialized source snapshot is signing authority without canonical accounting replay.
Database or checkpoint compiler access implies possession of checkpoint signing keys.
A stale signer trust bundle predating the checkpoint signature is sufficient revocation evidence.
Key rotation invalidates all historically valid checkpoints by default.
An unattested signer trust bundle is sufficient root trust authority.
A cryptographically valid trust bundle below the pinned minimum policy sequence is acceptable.
A checkpoint-backed allocation lineage without root-anchored signer trust is sufficient statement discharge authority.
A caller-supplied trust list is equivalent to trust evidence derived from the exact statement compiler input.
A caller-supplied conservation proof is authoritative for an EconomicAuditCapsule v2.
A structurally valid serialized audit capsule proves who produced or anchored it.
An EconomicAuditCapsule digest without a verified detached issuer attestation proves issuer identity.
Accounting, database or statement compiler access implies possession of audit-capsule issuer signing keys.
Pinning an audit attestation capabilityId is equivalent to pinning the exact capability root.
